Title: General availability: Azure Automation in Korea Central and West US 2 regions

Body.Content:
Azure Automation is now available in the Azure Korea Central and West US 2 regions. These new regions give you more options for locating Automation accounts in geographic locations that work best for you.

You can use Azure Automation to create, monitor, deploy, and maintain resources in your Azure, on-premises, and partner cloud environments. And you can accomplish that by using highly scalable and reliable process execution and desired state configuration engines, update management, and change tracking and inventory.

To learn more and get started with a free trial, see the Azure Automation overview.
